This is necessary for both reproducibility and security reasons to prevent dependencies from being resolved from other repositories without warning. items.summary: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a case of improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions.
